# CmisVcsRxOutputFineAmplitudeCode — CMIS-VCS 1.1 Rx Output Fine Amplitude Code

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisVcsRxOutputFineAmplitudeCode`
- Description: Code values of the OutputAmplitudeSettingRx&lt;i&gt; register (VCS Parameter ID 0Eh), OIF-CMIS-VCS-01.1 § 5.16 Table 5-35. The fine amplitude setting has 50 mV peak-to-peak resolution from 250 mV to 1000 mV, finer than the CMIS base amplitude target codes. The amplitude is measured without Rx output equalization at a test point defined by the relevant standard.
